name: browser-automation-studio
description: Browser Automation Studio CLI surface. Single source of truth for command groups, flag shapes, governance metadata, and proto-method bindings. Cross-validated at test time against generated Connect service descriptors (see cli/capture/manifest_proto_test.go). Manifest-driven command dispatch is being adopted incrementally per the proto+Connect migration plan; hand-coded domains continue to register through cli/domains until migrated.
